name: regex_match
title: Regex Match
description: Test if a string matches a regex pattern, returning "true" or "false" (strings, matching the boolean-emitter convention). Uses Rust's `regex` crate (Thompson NFA, linear-time, ReDoS-free). Pattern length > 512 chars or invalid patterns yield clear errors.
